mainEntity.name: When should a local business consider investing in Answer Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A local business should consider AEO when they notice an increase in voice search queries related to their services or location, or if they want to dominate local 'near me' searches. It's particularly beneficial for businesses with frequently asked questions about their offerings, hours, or location that can be answered concisely. If your target customers are increasingly using digital assistants or asking direct questions to search engines, investing in AEO becomes crucial to capture that immediate intent and secure direct visibility over competitors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local businesses should consider AEO when voice search and 'near me' queries are prevalent among their target audience, or when they want to provide immediate answers to common customer questions.
